limits: All nine-boss forecasts assume every invasion creep is cleared with every player eligible and each boss is successfully cleared.
Boss combat, HP-potion consumption and failed-attempt cost are not simulated in forecasts; heroes are invulnerable while real private-dungeon combat is simulated.
The six natural bot attempts all lose their statue during wave one; they are not completed campaigns or human win-rate evidence.
Fixed-branch bot policy, walking return and round-robin skills are not optimal human play; solo/party comparisons also depend on branch composition.
Comparison keeps current combat tuning; legacy is a pacing/density reference, not a full checkout replay of historical M3D.
